panels.title: API requests by client
panels.description: External requests to /api/v1, /api/doc and /api/ui from the nginx proxy access log, grouped by User-Agent category: browsers, crawlers and link previews, generic HTTP tools (curl, node, python-requests, ...) and identified apps (everything else). The tables below list individual User-Agents. Server-side calls from the web container bypass the proxy and are not counted.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (count_over_time({container="openrift-proxy-1"} |= " /api/" | pattern `<_> - - [<_>] "<_> <path> <_>" <_> <_> "<referer>" "<ua>" <_>` | path=~"/api/(v1/|doc|ui).*" | label_format client=`{{ if gt (count "(?i)bot([/;) -]|$)|crawler|spider|externalagent|externalhit|externalfetcher|chatgpt-user|claude-user|inspectiontool|headless|lighthouse|whatsapp|networkingextension" .ua) 0 }}(crawlers & previews){{ else if hasPrefix "Mozilla/" .ua }}(browsers){{ else if gt (count "(?i)^(curl|Wget|python-|python/|aiohttp|httpx|node|undici|Bun|Deno|axios|got|okhttp|Go-http-client|Java/|Apache-HttpClient|libwww-perl|PostmanRuntime|Insomnia|RestSharp|Dart|Microsoft\\.Data\\.Mashup|PowerShell|reqwest|colly|Ruby|PHP|GuzzleHttp|-$|x$)" .ua) 0 }}(generic tools){{ else }}(identified apps){{ end }}` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Non-browser clients (User-Agent)
panels.description: Scripts, tools, and bots hitting the API over the dashboard time range. The /developers page asks every client to identify itself like MyDeckTool/1.0 (contact) — generic agents here are consumers we cannot reach before a breaking change.

targets.expr: topk(500, sum by (ua) (count_over_time({container="openrift-proxy-1"} |= " /api/" | pattern `<_> - - [<_>] "<_> <path> <_>" <_> <_> "<referer>" "<ua>" <_>` | path=~"/api/(v1/|doc|ui).*" | ua !~ "Mozilla/.*" [$__range])))

panels.title: Third-party web apps (Origin header)
panels.description: Browser requests to the API from other websites, grouped by the Origin header the browser sets on cross-origin requests. Page scripts cannot change it, so it names the calling site. Only edge cache misses reach nginx, so this shows which sites call, not their full volume.

targets.expr: topk(500, sum by (origin) (count_over_time({container="openrift-proxy-1"} |= " /api/" | pattern `<_> - - [<_>] "<_> <path> <_>" <_> <_> "<_>" "<_>" "<_>" <_> uht=<_> "<origin>" "<_>"` | path=~"/api/(v1/|doc|ui).*" | origin != "-" | origin != "https://openrift.app" [$__range])))

panels.title: Non-browser requests by endpoint
panels.description: What the non-browser clients are fetching (query strings stripped, path ids and slugs collapsed to :id).

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (ua, endpoint) (count_over_time({container="openrift-proxy-1"} |= " /api/" | pattern `<_> - - [<_>] "<_> <path> <_>" <_> <_> "<referer>" "<ua>" <_>` | path=~"/api/(v1/|doc|ui).*" | ua !~ "Mozilla/.*" | label_format endpoint=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[A-Za-z0-9_-]*[0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{15,}" (regexReplaceAll "^/api/v1/(decks/share|collections/share|lists/share|meta/decks|meta/events|meta/legends|meta/players|decks|cards|sets|products)/[^/]+" (regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .path "") "/api/v1/${1}/:id") "/:id" }}` [$__range])))
